visual_review.identity_and_anatomy: Six complete gray-wolf poses preserve head, fur, yellow eyes, tail and quadruped anatomy. Paws articulate through raised, passing and extended contacts with small head/tail changes. Near/far limb overlap obscures individual paws in some poses; parent should inspect the packed loop for phase balance.

Fine semitransparent edge pixels require parent packing review; no generated pixels were repainted or alpha-cleaned here.
Loop, runtime scale, integration and game verification remain parent-owned and unverified.
